description: The Chinese text of ONE specific article/provision of a law, regulation, or judicial interpretation found via cn_search_laws — not the whole document. Extracted from the official PDF the NPC database itself serves (that database has no per-article JSON text field). Returns found:false with an explanation rather than a snippet when the article cannot be located or the PDF cannot be read — this tool never fabricates text.

article.description: Article number (13) or the Chinese citation itself ("第十三条", "十三条之一").

name: cn_law_article_text
title: Cn Law Article Text
